content: GitHub Issues read-only: gh 2.88.1 'gh issue view N --json title,labels,state,assignees,milestone,url,body,number,stateReason,closedByPullRequestsReferences -R owner/repo' reuses user auth (5000/hr). REST GET /repos/{o}/{r}/issues/{n} works unauthenticated for public repos (60/hr) or with PAT (5000/hr); 301 transferred, 404 no access, 410 deleted. GitHub App installation tokens 5000/hr min, authenticate as installation not user; overkill for read-only CLI, right for later hub webhook.
